purpose: GPU-kernel-name prefix -> launching SGLang Python interface, verified by reading the sglang sources at the commit above. Used as the provenance source for build_e2e_tasks.py when a CPU+GPU profiler trace is unavailable: on this 2-node GB300 K3 deployment the profiler records continuously from arm until num_steps is reached, so any CPU-activities trace large enough to cover serving concurrency trips the request watchdog while exporting.
